notes.title: Brainrot Royale has been released!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633183/e2d42675be233c0f4a01f398c34392c4c3b1784b.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, fellow Brainrot Royale enjoyers![/p][p][/p][p]The game has finally released in early access and we want to take the chance to talk a bit about its upcoming features.[/p][p][/p][p]We plan to release an update every week or two. The updates will contain new levels, playable characters or hazards that will make every session more unique.[/p][p][/p][p]Note that finishing a session will reward the player with Brainrot Coins! The winner of the session get an extra amount. You can see your current amount of Brainrot Coins on the title screen's bottom-left corner.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633183/2cf2138f54bcc2cceb39626069b03a926442e581.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]These coins don't serve a purpose right now, but in the short term, they will be used for an official shop where you will be able to unlock new accessories to wear with your desired character.[/p][p][/p][p]An official Discord server will also be added in the following updates to create a community hub for all interested players.[/p][p][/p][p]See you on the next update![/p]
